source: Fixture for issue 470: one value per address family from the architecture review of a real triage run on a 15-file Go package (#468). Co-change counts come from an analogous file pair in another repo: last 200 non-merge commits, commits of 30 files or fewer.

candidates.claim: An address family is held together only by argument order: Config's ServesV4/ServesV6, TargetV4/V6 and UnicastV4/V6, Prober's smV4/smV6, its "v4"/"A" literals and readyVar(ToUpper(af)), and Probe's six positional strings with its "AAAA" to "ip6" branch; swapping target and expected compiles. Build an afGate slice once from Config and pass one to Probe.
candidates.removes: per-family fields, literals and branches spread across three files

candidates.claim: readyVar's comment gives ready_v4 as its example; it returns READY_V4.
